summary: The agent resolved the issue of the customer not receiving statements.

intents.intent: Inquiry about missing credit card statement
intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं स्मिता पाटिल मेरा क्रेडिट कार्ड स्टेटमेंट ईमेल ... नहीं आ रहा।

issues.issue: Customer not receiving credit card statements via email.
issues.reason(s): Email address was not updated in the system.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the customer's email address and updated it.
intents.Process Request: Updated customer's email address in the system and resent the latest statement.
intents.resolution: Agent updated the email and resent the statement.
